newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's trade deficit falls sharply in '96.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's trade deficit falls sharply in '96.

text.p: Colombia's trade deficit fell 21 percent from $2.8 billion FOB in 1995 to $2.21 billion FOB in 1996, the National Statistics Department (DANE) said.
It said exports for the year totaled $10.5 billion while imports totaled $12.78 billion
The value of crude oil exports and exports of oil derivatives was up 32.4 percent over 1995, DANE said. ((-- Juan Guillermo Londono, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944))
